{
  "up": "Select compound_chembl_id (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical_smiles (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), compound_key (compound_records.compound_key), pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer docs.pubmed_id, fall back to docs.doi), assay_description (assays.description), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id (target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (target_dictionary.pref_name), target_organism (target_dictionary.organism).

Join molecule_dictionary INNER JOIN compound_structures ON molregno to guarantee non-null SMILES, INNER JOIN compound_records ON molregno, compound_records INNER JOIN activities ON record_id, activities INNER JOIN assays ON assay_id, assays INNER JOIN target_dictionary ON tid, compound_records INNER JOIN docs ON doc_id.

Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL230', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', compound_structures.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL, and at least one of docs.pubmed_id or docs.doi is non-null.

Do not deduplicate; preserve every qualifying activity row.

Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism."
}
